ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Admin Share Mount Via Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an admin share is mounted using net.exe

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ use\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\*\\\\*\\$.*")))
